gripOrHq.title: Priority Wreck
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: Broker
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

gripOrHq.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

scoreArea.rulesText: Choose a piece of rezzed ice when you score Ice Transmutation. That ice now has +1 strength, and each subroutine on it is repeated once. Treat this as if each repeated subroutine appeared immediately after the original subroutine.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Washington, D.C., City Grid
root.rulesText:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
root.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Corporate Negotiating Center
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, gain [1] for each agenda card stored in HQ that you show to Runner.

ice.title: Cinderella
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 6 - If trace is successful, end the run, trash a piece of hardware, and do 2 meat damage. This damage cannot be prevented.
